reply.thought: The first step is to verify the refunds reported by Alpha Co against the system's records. I will use the list_refunds() tool for this.

The refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds listed in the system. Now that the refunds are verified, I need to get the net balance for each customer who had orders in the batch to determine the payout amount. I will start by listing all orders to identify the customers.

I have listed the orders. The unique customers are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I must call net_balance(customer) for each of these customers to get the final payout amount. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme' (25415 cents). Next, I will check the net balance for 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch' (30973 cents). Next, I will check the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (25415), birch (30973), and cobalt (33028). Now I must record a payout for each customer using record_payout(customer, amount_cents). I will start with 'acme'.
Payout recorded successfully for 'acme'. Next, I will record the payout for 'birch' (30973 cents).
Payout recorded successfully for 'birch'. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt' (33028 cents).
All payouts have been recorded successfully for acme, birch, and cobalt. I can now finalize the task by providing the report.
